Agent Name: Orchestrator (thought)
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: It misinterpreted the “is pleasing to” semantics and case roles, treating apples as the object and “me” as the subject, yielding “Maktay Zapple Mato” instead of the correct “Maktay Mato Apple.” There was no loop involved (Rule 1); this is a clear misreading/misuse of provided data (Rule 2). Although later steps cemented the error, this initial misassignment was the core reasoning fault that led to the wrong final result (Rule 3).
